title: pi-extensions: how the toolbox fits together
description: What each package in the pi-extensions monorepo does, with the tidy tool cards, compaction model, follow-up, leader key and Cursor Cloud flows.

props.content: **pi-extensions** is one npm workspace of 12 independently publishable packages for the Pi coding agent. Most daily behaviour lives in one big package, `pi-ext`. The rest are small, single-purpose add-ons. Watch first for hidden coupling: several features depend on each other through events and settings, not imports, so a change in one place can quietly change another.

props.title: What can break
props.takeaway: Most risks come from things that look independent but are not.

rows.title: Subagents patch is wiped on reinstall
rows.body: `@tintinweb/pi-subagents` is patched locally. An agents2 update replaces the package folder and drops the patch.

rows.title: Haiku compaction was unproven in saved sessions
rows.body: The compaction design notes found no saved summary written by Haiku. Every logged attempt fell back. A later review saw one real success in a test session.
rows.next: Watch for a live automatic compaction.

rows.title: Catalog drift
rows.body: The root `pi` manifest must list every child resource by hand.

rows.title: Offline Haiku test
rows.body: Planned, not built: score Haiku against 927 saved session-model summaries with probe questions.

props.title: Twelve packages, three groups
props.deck: One big host, some model helpers, and stand-alone tools.
props.takeaway: If you remember one package, remember pi-ext.

props.title: One resolver draws every tool call
props.deck: Packages register tools. The tidy renderer decides how they look.

props.caption: Pi 1.0.4's registerToolRenderer lets tidy wrap every tool without touching its arguments or results.
edges: spec -> chill : if chill is on

props.content: A collapsed card is two lines (one in reasoning or result mode). A failure changes the colour but never Pi's `isError`. With **chill** on (`/chill`, or `chill: true` in `pi-tidy-tools.json`), finished calls fold into one `Worked · <count> tools · <duration>` line. Ctrl+O unfolds them. Unknown tools pass through unchanged, even in chill mode.

props.title: Open boundary
props.body: Chill mode does not hide Pi-managed image attachments. Review this if chill must hide every tool display.

props.title: Pick who writes the summary
props.deck: A setting chooses a cheaper model. The host falls back if it fails.
props.takeaway: Haiku writes the summary. The session model is the safety net.

props.content: The `compaction-model` extension reads a `compactionModel` block from settings: a model, a thinking level, which reasons apply (`manual`, `threshold`, `overflow`), an optional threshold percent and a summary budget of 24K tokens. It adds extra instructions to Pi's prompt, wraps the result with the first user message and a pointer to the session file, and records a card. The full story is in the compaction-flow explainer.

props.title: A second model guesses your next message
props.deck: It runs after long replies, in the background.
props.takeaway: It never falls back to the chat model.

props.content: Only visible assistant text counts toward the `threshold` (default 1,200 characters). The helper sees the last few messages and must call a `follow_up_suggestions` tool. Defaults: 3 suggestions, `openai-codex` with `gpt-5.6-luna`, low thinking. A `followUpModel` entry in `settings.json` overrides the model, so a managed profile can choose. An invalid config file stops the extension from loading instead of guessing. `/follow-up` shows the active values.

props.title: One key opens the menus
props.deck: Ctrl+X is the home menu. Other extensions add entries by event.

props.caption: Registration is an event, not an import.

props.content: `e` opens a searchable command picker. Team is `g`, Voice is `v`, Memory is `b`. Typing `$` at the start of a message lists skills, and `$name request` becomes `/skill:name request` on send. Ctrl+Shift+S copies the draft to the clipboard and clears the editor only if the copy worked.

props.title: Delegate to a cloud VM
props.deck: Local Pi keeps working while Cursor runs the task.
props.takeaway: The result arrives later as a follow-up message.

props.caption: Cloud agents see a GitHub repo and ref, not your local checkout.

props.content: Other tools: `cursor_cloud_send` (follow-up when idle), `cursor_cloud_cancel` and `cursor_cloud_status`. The default model is `composer-2.5`, changed with `/cloud model`. Each run is billed at Cursor Max Mode pricing. Completion renders as a tidy card, and `/cloud open` opens the agent's Cursor page.
